resources.name: Open-source quantum chemistry package (ORCA, Psi4, or similar)

access.url: https://psicode.org/ (Psi4) or https://orcaforum.kofo.mpg.de/ (ORCA, free with registration)
access.notes: Any package that supports QCISD geometry optimization and QCISD(T) single-point energy calculations with the 6-31G* and 6-311G** basis sets.

resources.notes: The agent must install a package capable of QCISD/6-31G* optimizations and QCISD(T)/6-311G** single-point energies.
